panels.title: Sessions flagged by the behavioral rules

targets.expr:
label_replace(count by (session) (
(sum by (session) (count_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | tty="" [5m])) >= 8)
and on (session)
(count by (session) (sum by (session, command_line) (count_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | tty="" [5m]))) >= 6)
and on (session)
(
  (
    max by (session) (max_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | tty="" | label_format ts=`{{ unixEpochMillis __timestamp__ }}` | unwrap ts [5m]))
    - min by (session) (min_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | tty="" | label_format ts=`{{ unixEpochMillis __timestamp__ }}` | unwrap ts [5m]))
  )
  / on (session)
  (sum by (session) (count_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | tty="" [5m])) - 1)
  >= 500 <= 10000
)
), "rule", "agent-command-cadence", "", "")

label_replace(count by (session) (
sum by (session) (
  rate_counter({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type=~"process_creation|network_connection"
    | label_format kind=`{{ if eq .event_type "process_creation" }}1{{ else if count "^(api[.]anthropic[.]com|api[.]openai[.]com|api[.]mistral[.]ai|api[.]cohere[.]ai|api[.]x[.]ai|api[.]deepseek[.]com|api[.]groq[.]com|api[.]together[.]xyz|openrouter[.]ai|generativelanguage[.]googleapis[.]com)$" .dest_host }}0{{ end }}`
    | kind != "" | keep session, kind | unwrap kind [5m])
) * 300 >= 2.5
), "rule", "agent-loop-interleave", "", "")

label_replace(count by (session) (
sum by (session) (
  sum_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | label_format exe=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[[:space:]].*" .command_line "" }}`, failed=`{{ if eq .exit_code "0" }}0{{ else }}1{{ end }}` | keep session, exe, failed | unwrap failed [5m])
  -
  last_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | label_format exe=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[[:space:]].*" .command_line "" }}`, failed=`{{ if eq .exit_code "0" }}0{{ else }}1{{ end }}` | keep session, exe, failed | unwrap failed [5m])
) >= 3
), "rule", "agent-retry-storm", "", "")

label_replace(count by (session) (
(
  max by (session) (max_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="network_connection" | dest_host=~`api[.]anthropic[.]com|api[.]openai[.]com|api[.]mistral[.]ai|api[.]cohere[.]ai|api[.]x[.]ai|api[.]deepseek[.]com|api[.]groq[.]com|api[.]together[.]xyz|openrouter[.]ai|generativelanguage[.]googleapis[.]com` | bytes_out >= 20000 | label_format ts=`{{ unixEpochMillis __timestamp__ }}` | unwrap ts [10m]))
  - on (session)
  max by (session) (max_over_time({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type="process_creation" | command_line=~`(?i).*([.]aws/credentials|[.]ssh/id_|/etc/shadow|[.]kube/config|[.]git-credentials|(^|[[:space:]])secret|(^|[[:space:]])token|password).*` | label_format ts=`{{ unixEpochMillis __timestamp__ }}` | unwrap ts [10m]))
) >= 0 <= 180000
), "rule", "sensitive-read-llm-exfil", "", "")

panels.title: Model call to command cycles per session (fires at 2.5)

targets.expr:
sum by (session) (
  rate_counter({job="agentdetect"} | json | event_type=~"process_creation|network_connection"
    | label_format kind=`{{ if eq .event_type "process_creation" }}1{{ else if count "^(api[.]anthropic[.]com|api[.]openai[.]com|api[.]mistral[.]ai|api[.]cohere[.]ai|api[.]x[.]ai|api[.]deepseek[.]com|api[.]groq[.]com|api[.]together[.]xyz|openrouter[.]ai|generativelanguage[.]googleapis[.]com)$" .dest_host }}0{{ end }}`
    | kind != "" | keep session, kind | unwrap kind [5m])
) * 300
